exposure: Age groups (21-30 years, other age groups)
cohort: 216 pregnant women with a gestational age of more than 24 weeks, excluding women with risk factors for fetal distress and breech in late labor
finding: Apgar score of less than six at one minute was significantly associated with meconium staining of amniotic fluid.
mod_finding: No significant association was found between Apgar score and meconium staining with respect to the mode of delivery.
